# City Council

## MISSION STATEMENT

The City Council is committed to governing in a respectful, fair, transparent and financially responsible manner, to promote economic vitality, excellent public health and safety and to maintain a sustainable budget in order to provide a positive, productive and high quality of life for the residents and stakeholders of El Monte.

## Agendas &amp; Minutes

Agendas are available prior to the meetings. Minutes are available following approval.

[View Most Recent Agendas and Minutes](https://elmonteca.gov/AgendaCenter/MostRecent/City-Council-3-3)

## Overview

The Mayor and City Council are elected by the voters of El Monte and are responsible for overseeing the delivery of local government services to the residents of the city.
